name: @gntrees/sql-builder
description: Multi-language SQL query builder generated from a gntrees project definition.

scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres mysql
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm migrate-postgres && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm migrate-mysql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v && bun run db:up && bun run db:migrate
